description: This file defines a Swing UI component 'ZoomControl' for managing zoom levels within an application, including buttons for zooming in, zooming out, and resetting zoom, as well as keyboard shortcuts.

classes.name: ZoomControl
classes.description: A Swing JPanel component that provides zoom in/out controls and reset functionality, with keyboard shortcuts and callback support.

methods.name: ZoomControl
methods.description: Constructor initializing zoom control UI components and key bindings.

methods.name: bindKeyStrokeActions
methods.description: Sets up keyboard shortcuts for zooming in and out.

methods.name: zoomIn
methods.description: Increases the zoom value by a factor of 1.1.

methods.name: zoomOut
methods.description: Decreases the zoom value by dividing by 1.1.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the zoom value and updates UI state accordingly.

methods.name: getZoomProvider
methods.description: Returns an external zoom provider interface.
